frame.fetch: every closed event of both tags (union by id; no date bound, so key-excluded events define the overlap drops)
frame.key_rule: event id / member market id key drop, then every event whose window overlaps a key-excluded earthquake event (counted by source); > 30% dropped -> 'population thinned by exclusions'

parser.written_from: out-of-window events only (endDate >= 2026-10-01), text read 2026-10-19; no price or outcome

model.e_c: empirical share of days 2000-01-01..2024-09-01 in the rule's own day (UTC or ET) whose rounded maximum is in the bucket; no M >= 4.5 -> lowest bucket
model.horizon: NegBin(mean lambda tau, size k tau / 30)
model.k: method of moments; var <= mean -> Poisson

cb12_e.stage1: p < 0.01, floor, both binding placebos, robustness, early Holm at alpha / 10

stage2.e1_rep: p_t = first 16:00Z read mid, p_reg = first 10:00Z read mid of the same day, p_alt = 16:00Z read 48 h earlier; outcome from the first read >= 72 h after the window end
stage2.end: later of start + 56 d and 30 resolved components, never after start + 90 d
stage2.power: >= 100 units and >= 30 window components, else not run (power), counted
stage2.start: first earthquake market listed >= 1 day after the E freeze
stage2.usgs: one read from the earliest open window start (cap 400 d), M >= 4.5; stored: >= 5.5 over the span + every event of the last 10 d

anchor.direct: listed expiry == d: (C(K_lo) - C(K_hi)) / (K_hi - K_lo) from two-sided call mids, clipped [0, 1]; listed K -> the strikes immediately below and above

exclusions.earnings: flag only (primary includes all); robustness excludes flagged units if the smoke verified the calendar keyless
exclusions.ex_dividend: source nasdaq_previous_session: an ex-date in (ET date of t, d] in the PREVIOUS session's Nasdaq file, or no valid entry there -> excluded; cash-settled indices (CBOE _SPX/_NDX/_RUT) exempt

anchor.phi_d2: else Phi(d2), iv linear in strike at K from the nearest expiry >= d, spot = chain underlying price, r = 0, T under the smoke-chosen convention (none -> excluded)

collection.daily: Yahoo daily bars before the day; Nasdaq earnings rows of the frame symbols over [day, max settlement] (<= 45 d); Nasdaq ex-dividend dates per equity / ETF (ETF list frozen, else stocks then etf); the file of session S feeds the units of the NEXT session only
collection.missed: unavailable (collection), never back-filled; host disk refusal at a due checkpoint -> unavailable (host disk)
collection.order: frame -> chain -> book read 1 -> book read 2 (>= 60 s)
collection.outcomes: outcomes_guarded/<d>/ only: Yahoo close of d (implemented as fetched on a later ET date than d) and Gamma resolution (unresolved rows asked again every outcome step); final when complete or 7 days after d
collection.root_cap: the collector root's own size is capped at --disk-cap-gb (0.3); beyond it a due checkpoint is 'unavailable (host disk)'

frame.rule_flags_use: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY: stored booleans and the description sha256; no flag includes, excludes or weights a unit or enters a test (amendment O3)
frame.settlement: title date (on <Month> <day>) or the month's last session (end of <Month>), year closest to endDate; > 3 days from endDate's ET date -> ambiguous (excluded)

cb12_o.label: prospective (window 1 Stage 1; window 2 L2); not independent of CB9-P

o1.agreement: Yahoo vs Gamma outcome agreement counted per market
o1.attribution: q_RV (20-day realised vol); joint coefficient >= half solo; cor > 0.9 -> not identifiable (screen: the census value of cor(q - m1, q_RV - m1); rep: the tested units')
o1.checkpoint_share: scheduled checkpoints missed (unavailable (collection) / (host disk)) multiply the unit availability share
o1.robustness: direct-digital; each checkpoint; earnings excluded (if identified); halves; top-5 per way
o1.stat: WLS slope of Y - m2 on q - m1, cluster (ticker, d) weight 1

o2.availability: o2_ok units over o2_ok + unavailable units
o2.eligibility: first-read tight + valid anchor (o2_ok); the second read (>= 60 s after the decision) is for O1 only

o2.robustness: +0.005 on the ask; halves; top-5 per way
o2.rule: first tight checkpoint with q - a_YES >= 0.04 or (1 - q) - a_NO >= 0.04
